```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Vout collapsed because the replica was not a true scaled copy: min-width clamping broke the W3/W2 vs W5/W1 ratio, so M2 sourced ~74 uA and M1 went triode. Use one common scale k for both replica devices, raised until neither is clamped. Re-centre Vout with higher PMOS gm/Id and keep 5% power margin."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (92e-6, 80e-6, 96e-6),   # main branch current
    "Ln":     (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),         # input device L (also M5/M6)
    "Lp":     (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),         # PMOS load / replica diode L
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),       # PMOS load gm/Id (sets Vsg -> Vout)
    "r":      (0.05, 0.03, 0.08),      # replica branch current / I1
    "t1":     (1.0, 0.9, 1.1),         # trim of M6 width (fine Vout trim)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]
    Ln, Lp = p["Ln"], p["Lp"]
    WMIN = 0.5

    # PMOS load: gm/Id sets Vsg, which sets the output DC level
    vsg = 1.0
    for _ in range(4):
        m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I1, vds=vsg)
        vsg = m2.vgs
    W2 = m2.W
    vout_t = VDD - vsg

    # Input NMOS: Id(vgs=vin, vds=vout_t) = I1
    W1 = 20.0
    for _ in range(10):
        Id_t = lut.op("n", W1, Ln, vin, vout_t)["Id"]
        W1 = W1 * I1 / max(Id_t, 1e-12)
    W1 = min(max(W1, WMIN), 5000)
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, Ln, vin, vout_t)

    # Reference diode M6 (same L as M1): Vgs = vin at iref
    W6 = 2.0
    for _ in range(10):
        Id_t = lut.op("n", W6, Ln, vin, vin)["Id"]
        W6 = W6 * iref / max(Id_t, 1e-12)
    W6 = min(max(W6 * p["t1"], WMIN), 5000)

    # Replica branch: one common scale k for BOTH devices (no clamp-induced ratio error).
    # M5 = k*M1 (gate at ibias ~ vin), M3 = k*M2 (diode). Drain of M5 = VDD - Vsg3 = vout_t,
    # so M1/M2 are an exact scaled copy of M5/M3 -> Vout = vout_t by construction.
    k = p["r"]
    k = max(k, WMIN / W1, WMIN / W2)
    W5 = W1 * k
    W3 = W2 * k
    I5 = I1 * k

    op2 = lut.op("p", W2, Lp, vsg, VDD - vout_t)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M6", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W6, Ln)
    n.M("M5", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, Ln)
    n.M("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, Lp)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, Lp)
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, Ln)

    gm = op1["gm"]
    gds = op1["gds"] + op2["gds"]
    A = gm / gds
    # output node cap: load + drain junction / overlap of M1, M2 (rough)
    cpar = 1.0e-15 * (0.6 * W1 + 0.6 * W2)
    cout = cl + cpar
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    f3 = gds / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = VDD * (iref + I5 + I1)
    swing = VDD - op1["vdsat"] - op2["vdsat"] - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": swing, "inverting": 1}
```
